messages:
katie.pm: quick sync — need to lock how we sequence the customer-driven tokenizer-switch experiment. product asked for a progressive rollout but legal wants strong rollback hooks. thoughts?
omar.eng: short answer: phased canary + automatic fallback. we should plan for feature-flag guardrails and emergency off.
lee.sre: agree. add traffic shaping by customer slice, not just global %. want SRE runbook for escalation.
maya.data: we can provide a sliced metric bundle per cohort (latency, error_rate, hallucination-rate). should we treat high-value customers as their own slice?
katie.pm: yes — that's the ask. they want 3 groups: test customers (internal), VIP customers (~5%), and general. VIPs get a soft opt-in, test customers are full coverage.
chris.te: question: do we quantify impact vs effort? RICE for this feels fuzzy because rollout risk is high. maybe use a risk-adjusted impact score.
omar.eng: propose this sequence: 1) internal dev traffic (0-1%) 2) internal prod samples (1-5%) 3) VIP cohort (5%) 4) 20% ramp 5) 100% if metrics ok. include immediate fallback to previous model whenever error_rate > 0.7% for 5m or latency p95 > 250ms for 3m.
katie.pm: can we codify those thresholds into the rollout config so deploy-bot can auto-stop?
lee.sre: deploy-bot needs the exact rules. sample YAML:```rollout:
  stages:
    - name: dev-sanity
      pct: 1
      cohorts: internal
    - name: vip-soft
      pct: 5
      cohorts: vip
    - name: ramp-20
      pct: 20
      cohorts: general
  abort_conditions:
    - metric: error_rate
      threshold: 0.007
      duration: 300
    - metric: latency_p95
      threshold_ms: 250
      duration: 180
  fallback: reroute_to: v1
```
maya.data: looks good. I'll wire up dashboards and an automated evaluation that compares generation-quality against our golden prompts. we'll flag regressions > 2% BLEU drop or manual eval failures.
chris.te: for prioritization, propose scoring: Impact = projected unit savings + customer retention weight, Effort = infra + playbook complexity, Risk = likelihood*impact. then RICE' = (Impact/Effort) * (1 - Risk). use this to sequence parallel experiments.
katie.pm: love that. can you sketch numbers for tokenizer-switch by EOD?
omar.eng: also note dependencies: quantized runtime changes might need Dedicated capacity for consistent p99s. that's a procurement lead time of ~3 weeks. factor that into sequencing.
lee.sre: runbook snippets: - on abort: block new arrivals to v2, drain KV cache, revert serving config, notify #incidents and #customer-support. - after rollback: auto-create postmortem ticket template.
deploy-bot: deployment queued for v2-tokenizer -> awaiting manual start. :eyes:
katie.pm: action items: @maya.data -> dashboards + golden prompt eval; @omar.eng -> write rollout config + procurement note; @lee.sre -> runbook + incident hooks; @chris.te -> RICE' scoring spreadsheet. sync tomorrow 10am to approve gating. :thumbsup:
